Hi Karthik,

Thanks for sending the draft MSA + order form. Our legal team reviewed and there are a few substantive redlines we need to resolve before procurement advances:

- Output ownership: Verdant needs assignment or an exclusive (for certain product lines) entitlement to the outputs created by our users. We cannot accept broad vendor retention of downstream commercialization rights.
- Training/data use: any use of customer inputs to further train models must be opt-in and explicitly scoped. We need a guarantee that training will not occur without documented consent and a clear deletion window.
- Feedback license: we are prepared to provide feedback for model improvement but want that license limited to non-exclusive, non-commercial model-improvement uses and to data that is de-identified.
- Telemetry/audit: we need access to telemetry showing how our prompts are used and an audit log of any training events that involve our data.

I attached a marked-up version of the MSA with tracked changes (Verdant_Redlines_MSA.docx). Can Redwood provide proposed replacement language for the three bullets above? We are hoping to close contracting this month.

Thanks,

Elena / team —

I reviewed Verdant's tracked changes. Below are targeted proposals intended to be executable while preserving Redwood’s product and model-safety obligations. Inline snippets follow and I’m happy to push them into the doc if you prefer.

1) Output / productization
Proposed compromise: Redwood grants Verdant a non-exclusive, worldwide, sublicensable (to Verdant’s end customers) license to use Outputs for Verdant’s internal and commercial purposes, subject to an attribution clause. Full assignment will be considered only for defined modules (e.g., a specified trained model delivered under separate SOW) and is out of scope for the standard Order Form.

2) Training / data use
Proposed language: "Redwood will not use Customer Data to train, fine-tune, or improve models used for customer-facing productization without Customer's prior written opt-in. If Customer opts in, Redwood will apply de-identification techniques and provide a 90-day notice window before material training events impacting Customer Data."

3) Feedback license and telemetry
Proposed: "Customer grants Redwood a limited, non-exclusive, royalty-free license to use Feedback solely to improve Redwood’s service quality, safety, and operational reliability. Feedback shall exclude any proprietary source code, and Redwood will provide Customer with a redacted summary of model changes that materially affect output behavior upon request."

4) Evidence & auditability
We can add an audit-rights schedule for a defined period and include a telemetry feed showing token counts and model variants used. For security-sensitive customers we can also add a KMS/HSM requirement.

Next steps: if Verdant agrees with the approach above, I will prepare exact MSA/Order Form redline language and a short mutual action plan for signatures. If we need an assignment for a particular feature, we should scope that in an SOW with separate commercial terms.

Thanks for the patience while we drafted language. Summary of proposed path forward (we tried to balance Verdant’s productization needs and Redwood’s product safety and IP model):

- Outputs: Redwood will grant Verdant a non-exclusive commercial license to Outputs produced via Verdant’s paid usage. For any component Verdant specifically wants assigned (e.g., a trained weights bundle or custom model), we will handle that via a separate SOW with clear deliverables and pricing.
- Training: Redwood will not train on Verdant customer data without explicit opt-in. If Verdant opts in, Redwood will detail de-identification steps and provide notification before material training events.
- Feedback license: limited-purpose, non-exclusive license for service quality and safety improvements only. Redwood will not use Feedback for third-party commercialization.
- Auditability: We will supply token-level telemetry and a periodic summary of training activities that include Verdant data identifiers (redacted as needed).
